_comment: Memory-anchor CURRENCY ATTESTATIONS (sc-22667, epic sc-22657). An anchor's currency key is normally derived at its own measurement revision (scripts/anchor-loader-closure.mjs --stamp-anchors), so a pin bump that touches the model's loader closure stales it. This repository's invalidation doctrine is two-gated: a differing closure digest is not evidence that memory behaviour changed - only a load-or-device-path change without a behaviour witness is. An entry here records, per anchor, that the closure diff from `measuredRevision` to `attestedRevision` was read file by file and is accounting-only (contract pricing, byte walkers, facts, tests, docs) or is witnessed unchanged by a re-measure on the same hardware; `--stamp-anchors` then derives that anchor's key at `attestedRevision` and copies the attestation into the store's `source.currencyAttestation`. The attestation is BOUNDED: it names one revision, `measuredRevision` must still equal the cited record's inference revision, and a later pin bump that moves the loader closure past `attestedRevision` stales the anchor again until it is re-read (a new entry) or re-captured (delete the entry). Never write one for a load-or-device-path change without a measured witness - that is the false green the currency key exists to prevent. Reviewed narrative: docs/calibration/sc-22657/anchor-currency-attestation-sc-22667.md (c6d6a4db, sc-22667; extended to 8a65db2a by the sc-22723 feature pin, and to 563c44e1, 3b922bac, e16c6a55, e34d7b46 and e11fd9f0 by the sc-22738 terminal pins; the nine sc-22738 measured lower bounds on file at e16c6a55 are attested from 3b922bac by the same reading (two in PR #2782, seven in the campaign evidence PR that carries their records) - a bound is stamped by the same --stamp-anchors walk and held to the same two-gated doctrine, and its attestation claims only that the diff cannot change the peak the stop was reached at).

attestations.why: 3cd86ba2..c6d6a4db DOES touch the Krea loader path (candle-gen-krea loader.rs / pipeline.rs / transformer/mod.rs / control*.rs, candle-gen quant/mod.rs + quant/adapt.rs, candle-gen-boogu, candle-gen-qwen-image and candle-gen-pid files the closure reaches), so the diff alone cannot classify this anchor. It is attested on a MEASURED witness instead: the E6 falsification fixture re-measured krea_2_turbo q4 at a5f643ae (22 first-parent merges after 3cd86ba2) on the same GPU and the cold staged control reproduces the packaged anchor per phase. The remaining a5f643ae..c6d6a4db range is accounting-only: gen-core lib.rs (re-export), memory_strategy.rs (contract types), weightsmeta.rs (walker hidden-cache skip) and candle-gen quant/sidecar.rs (CACHE_DIR constant re-homed, same value). Extended to 8a65db2a (sc-22723 feature pin, inference PRs #946-#958): c6d6a4db..8a65db2a touches four files of this closure and none is a load or device path - gen-core encoder_contract.rs (packed-marker struct kept whole, a stale-marker allowance only mlx-gen-flux2 calls, the hf_cache_discovery_roots authorization helper, tests), gen-core lib.rs (its re-export), gen-core wan_i2v_memory.rs (Wan-only identity tokens) and candle-gen-krea lib.rs (the per-(route, proven tier) identity table and weights-free surfaces; the q4 turbo identity this anchor is keyed to is unchanged, and the new provable-tier read consults the marker the loader already validated). loader.rs, pipeline.rs, transformer/, control*.rs, candle-gen quant/ and every device path are untouched. Extended to 563c44e1 (sc-22738, the epic final pin = inference main, merge of feature PR #960 over main 1cd0e393): 8a65db2a..563c44e1 changes nine inference files and exactly two are in this closure, gen-core encoder_contract.rs and lib.rs. Both are a REMOVAL, not a change of behaviour: inference PR #961 (sync of main into the feature branch) drops the sc-22727 stale-packed-marker tolerance that sc-22760 made unnecessary - the two entry points `source_for_load_with_stale_packed_marker` / `validate_source_for_discovery_with_stale_packed_marker`, the `RequiredWithStalePackedMarker` policy arm and its `stale_packed_marker()` reader, the `declared_quant` rewrite in `validate_source_with_policy` that was the identity for every other policy, `PackedQuantization` back to crate-private, and the allowance test; lib.rs drops the matching re-export. The only production caller of the removed surface was mlx-gen-flux2 (the FLUX.2 Klein turnkey inventory), which this closure does not reach; `source_for_load`, `validate_source_for_discovery`, `requires_config` for `Required` and every shard/header/quantization-evidence check this model executes are byte-for-byte the same code path before and after. The remaining seven files (mlx-gen-flux2 artifact_inventory.rs / loader.rs / memory_strategy.rs / model.rs, its two test files, release/real-weight-models.toml) are outside this closure. No load or device path this anchor reaches changed. Extended to 3b922bac (sc-22738, inference main = the merge of PR #962 over 563c44e1, its first parent): 563c44e1..3b922bac changes fourteen inference files, all under crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea and crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea-realtime (the harness-authorized calibration_fault hooks at every phase exit of the MLX krea base and realtime generators, their memory_strategy.rs helpers and tests), and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is EMPTY - this is the CANDLE krea closure (candle-gen-krea and candle-gen), which never links mlx-gen-krea or mlx-gen-krea-realtime. The closure digest is byte-identical across the range (config/anchor-loader-closures.json records the same digest for this model at 563c44e1 and 3b922bac; only krea_2_raw:mlx and krea_2_turbo:mlx moved), so this is the trivial extension the bump script's remediation names: nothing this anchor loads or executes changed, and no file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement. Extended to e16c6a55 (sc-22738 fourth terminal pin, 2026-09-07; inference main = the merge of PR #965 fix/sc-22738-wan-rehost-tolerance over #964 fix/sc-22738-wan-t2v-memory-contract over #963 fix/sc-22738-mlx-progress-boundaries over 3b922bac): 3b922bac..e16c6a55 changes eleven inference files (gen-core residency.rs and wan_i2v_memory.rs; mlx-gen-bernini bernini.rs and its conformance test; mlx-gen-mage model.rs and pipeline.rs; mlx-gen-wan config.rs, i2v_memory_strategy.rs, memory_strategy.rs and model.rs; one mlx-gen-flux real-weight test) and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is exactly ONE file, crates/contracts/gen-core/src/residency.rs. That diff is instrumentation-only (+195/-8, of which 147 lines are new unit tests): ensure_warm_locked drops its on_progress parameter and no longer emits Loading(TextEncoder)/Loading(Renderer) itself; the two warm (!stage_residency) arms of run_request_scoped and run_staged_request_scoped emit Loading(TextEncoder) before the warm load and Loading(Renderer) AFTER the prompt encode, both gated on the new warm_needs_load; the staged arms, run_two_phase, the components loaded, their order, their devices and the offload policy are byte-identical. This anchor was measured on the STAGED arm (measuredRegime.staged = true: the 3cd86ba2 capture drove candle-gen-krea's run_request_scoped with stage_residency), which the diff does not touch, so neither what it loads nor where the phase boundaries it was cut on fall changed. No file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement. EXTENDED to e34d7b46 (sc-22738, fifth terminal pin; inference main = PR #966 fix/sc-22738-sensenova-measurable over e16c6a55): the e16c6a55..e34d7b46 range changes five inference files, all under crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-sensenova (src/memory_strategy.rs, src/model.rs, src/t2i.rs and the two parity tests), and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles (143 files) is EMPTY - the closure is byte-identical across the range and derives the same currency key at e34d7b46 as at e16c6a55. The trivial extension the doctrine names; no file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement and no re-measure was taken. EXTENDED to e11fd9f0 (sc-22738, sixth terminal pin; inference main = PR #967 fix/sc-22738-candle-kolors-ideogram-predicates over e34d7b46, its first parent): the e34d7b46..e11fd9f0 range changes exactly three inference files, all a candle-gen memory_strategy.rs - candle-gen-kolors (dense/non-packed tensors may be F16 as well as BF16, since the shipped rehost's shards are F16 and every dense tensor is read at F32), candle-gen-ideogram (the VAE's rank-0 I32/I64 BatchNorm counter is priced at zero, and the turbo id stops refusing the co-located unconditional_transformer/ its loader never opens) and candle-gen-bernini (contract_for_loaded and validate_loaded_contract publish the calibration identity memory_strategy_contract already computed). The intersection with this closure's closureFiles (143 files) is EMPTY, and stronger than empty: this closure reaches no file of ANY of the three crates (grep over closureFiles for candle-gen-kolors / candle-gen-ideogram / candle-gen-bernini: 0 hits), so the closure is byte-identical across the range and derives the same currency key at e11fd9f0 as at e34d7b46 (config/anchor-loader-closures.json records the same digest for this model at both pins; only bernini:candle, bernini_image:candle, ideogram_4:candle, ideogram_4_turbo:candle and kolors:candle moved). The trivial extension the doctrine names; no file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement and no re-measure was taken. sc-23026 pin extension (e11fd9f0fd26..81fda3bd5a9d): reviewed the changed inference files (crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-flux2/src/lib.rs, crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-ltx/src/lib.rs, crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-ltx/src/memory_strategy.rs, crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-minimax-h3/src/memory_strategy.rs). None intersects this model/backend's old or new closureFiles, and its derived loader digest is unchanged. The existing witness and accounting classification therefore extend without another measurement. sc-23053 pin extension (81fda3bd5a9d..8fb95eb05cee): the changed inference files have an EMPTY intersection with this Candle model loader closure. The shared MLX native read-completion repair is not linked into this Candle path. Its first-party loader digest is unchanged; the existing classification extends without a new measurement. sc-23108 pin extension (8fb95eb05cee..e3de348f4dde): reviewed all five changed files, exclusively MiniMax-H3 MLX AdaLN evaluation and its tests. Their intersection with this model/backend loader closure is EMPTY; its closureFiles and derived digest are byte-identical across the range. The existing classification extends without a new measurement. Extended to 8b43c354 (inference PR #972, sc-23187): e3de348f..8b43c354 changes only the MLX SDXL tokenizer, three MLX Flux2 files, and a diagnostic document. The intersection with this Candle loader closure is empty and its derived digest is byte-identical; no load or device path reachable by this anchor changed.

Extended to 8a65db2a (sc-22723 feature pin, inference PRs #946-#958): c6d6a4db..8a65db2a touches four files of this closure and none is a load or device path - gen-core encoder_contract.rs (packed-marker struct kept whole with same-value accessors, a stale-marker allowance only mlx-gen-flux2 calls, the hf_cache_discovery_roots authorization helper, tests), gen-core lib.rs (its re-export), gen-core wan_i2v_memory.rs (Wan-only identity tokens) and candle-gen-z-image memory_strategy.rs, whose selected_encoder_discovery_roots now authorizes the HF-cache repository dir as a symlink target for the text-encoder planning-facts readers - a validation gate, not a load: the same bytes reach the same device the same way. pipeline.rs, model.rs, the loader and every device-format path are untouched. Extended to 563c44e1 (sc-22738, the epic final pin = inference main, merge of feature PR #960 over main 1cd0e393): 8a65db2a..563c44e1 changes nine inference files and exactly two are in this closure, gen-core encoder_contract.rs and lib.rs. Both are a REMOVAL, not a change of behaviour: inference PR #961 (sync of main into the feature branch) drops the sc-22727 stale-packed-marker tolerance that sc-22760 made unnecessary - the two entry points `source_for_load_with_stale_packed_marker` / `validate_source_for_discovery_with_stale_packed_marker`, the `RequiredWithStalePackedMarker` policy arm and its `stale_packed_marker()` reader, the `declared_quant` rewrite in `validate_source_with_policy` that was the identity for every other policy, `PackedQuantization` back to crate-private, and the allowance test; lib.rs drops the matching re-export. The only production caller of the removed surface was mlx-gen-flux2 (the FLUX.2 Klein turnkey inventory), which this closure does not reach; `source_for_load`, `validate_source_for_discovery`, `requires_config` for `Required` and every shard/header/quantization-evidence check this model executes are byte-for-byte the same code path before and after. The remaining seven files (mlx-gen-flux2 artifact_inventory.rs / loader.rs / memory_strategy.rs / model.rs, its two test files, release/real-weight-models.toml) are outside this closure. No load or device path this anchor reaches changed. Extended to 3b922bac (sc-22738, inference main = the merge of PR #962 over 563c44e1, its first parent): 563c44e1..3b922bac changes fourteen inference files, all under crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea and crates/media/mlx-gen/mlx-gen-krea-realtime (the harness-authorized calibration_fault hooks at every phase exit of the MLX krea base and realtime generators, their memory_strategy.rs helpers and tests), and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is EMPTY - the Z-Image candle closure (candle-gen-z-image) never links either krea crate. The closure digest is byte-identical across the range (config/anchor-loader-closures.json records the same digest for this model at 563c44e1 and 3b922bac; only krea_2_raw:mlx and krea_2_turbo:mlx moved), so this is the trivial extension the bump script's remediation names: nothing this anchor loads or executes changed, and no file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement. Extended to e16c6a55 (sc-22738 fourth terminal pin, 2026-09-07; inference main = the merge of PR #965 fix/sc-22738-wan-rehost-tolerance over #964 fix/sc-22738-wan-t2v-memory-contract over #963 fix/sc-22738-mlx-progress-boundaries over 3b922bac): 3b922bac..e16c6a55 changes eleven inference files (gen-core residency.rs and wan_i2v_memory.rs; mlx-gen-bernini bernini.rs and its conformance test; mlx-gen-mage model.rs and pipeline.rs; mlx-gen-wan config.rs, i2v_memory_strategy.rs, memory_strategy.rs and model.rs; one mlx-gen-flux real-weight test) and the intersection with this closure's closureFiles is exactly ONE file, crates/contracts/gen-core/src/residency.rs. That diff is instrumentation-only (+195/-8, of which 147 lines are new unit tests): ensure_warm_locked drops its on_progress parameter and no longer emits Loading(TextEncoder)/Loading(Renderer) itself; the two warm (!stage_residency) arms of run_request_scoped and run_staged_request_scoped emit Loading(TextEncoder) before the warm load and Loading(Renderer) AFTER the prompt encode, both gated on the new warm_needs_load; the staged arms, run_two_phase, the components loaded, their order, their devices and the offload policy are byte-identical. candle-gen-z-image links gen-core but never drives gen_core::residency::Residency (the crate has no run_request_scoped, run_staged_request_scoped or run_two_phase call); residency.rs is in this closure only as a gen-core module and is unreached by the Z-Image Candle load and render path. No file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement. The trivial extension the doctrine names; no file is added to filesChangedSinceMeasurement and no re-measure was taken. sc-23026 pin extension (e11fd9f0fd26..81fda3bd5a9d): reviewed the changed inference files (crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-flux2/src/lib.rs, crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-ltx/src/lib.rs, crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-ltx/src/memory_strategy.rs, crates/media/candle-gen/candle-gen-minimax-h3/src/memory_strategy.rs). None intersects this model/backend's old or new closureFiles, and its derived loader digest is unchanged. The existing witness and accounting classification therefore extend without another measurement. sc-23053 pin extension (81fda3bd5a9d..8fb95eb05cee): the changed inference files have an EMPTY intersection with this Candle model loader closure. The shared MLX native read-completion repair is not linked into this Candle path. Its first-party loader digest is unchanged; the existing classification extends without a new measurement. sc-23108 pin extension (8fb95eb05cee..e3de348f4dde): reviewed all five changed files, exclusively MiniMax-H3 MLX AdaLN evaluation and its tests. Their intersection with this model/backend loader closure is EMPTY; its closureFiles and derived digest are byte-identical across the range. The existing classification extends without a new measurement. The intersection with this Candle loader closure is empty and its derived digest is byte-identical; no load or device path reachable by this anchor changed.
